frozen_before: any Civil Comments LLM S-versus-A result (GPT, Claude, or Gemini); no LLM score joined to A or Z
cutoff_basis: logistics only: 44,462 unresolved rows vs ~29,100/day observed capacity across three authorized projects; three further daily quota windows = ~2x requirement; remaining schedule reserved for freeze, 24-test analysis, sensitivities, negative controls, verification, paper integration, and two-page compile
cutoff_immutable: may not be chosen again or moved after any LLM S-versus-A result is visible

rules.preserve: all successful scores, all frozen invalid-response exclusions, all frozen quota technical exclusions
rules.infrastructure_decisions_outcome_blind: blind to A, Z, Detoxify, GPT, Claude, and Gemini score values
rules.at_cutoff_if_incomplete: stop inference; preserve partial store; record valid/invalid/technical/unresolved N, request-order ranges, credential segments, stop reason; provider-level incomplete-scoring deviation; never convert never-attempted rows to item-level technical exclusions
rules.if_incomplete_do_not_redefine_24_test_fa: stop before computing the family and report coverage/deviation to the user
